steps.npc: This is our agility course, we use it to stay nimble and to keep our wits sharp. My name is Bobawu and I look after the course.
As a friend and fellow monkey, you're free to use it anytime, but you'll need to be as nimble as a ninja first!

steps.player: Are there any rewards you can offer me?

options.text: How many laps have I done?

steps.player: Could you tell me how many laps I've completed?

steps.text: If Monkey Madness II is not completed:

steps.npc: I can't offer you anything for now, so I don't see much reason to count your laps either.

steps.text: You need to complete Monkey Madness 2 for Bobawu to offer rewards and to count your lap total
If no laps have been completed:
If one lap has been completed:

steps.npc: Sure thing my friend, so far you've completed 1 lap, don't stop now!

steps.text: If more than one lap has been completed:

steps.npc: Sure thing my friend, so far you've completed [number] laps, keep it up!

steps.text: If Monkey Madness II is not completed:

steps.npc: I can't offer you anything for now, so I don't see much reason to count your laps either.

steps.text: You need to complete Monkey Madness 2 for Bobawu to offer rewards and to count your lap total
If Monkey Madness II is completed:

steps.npc: I see you have your own monkey friend, by completing laps here you can transform him into different monkeys!

steps.player: That's neat, what can he turn into?

steps.text: Bobawu pulls out a tattered piece of paper from his ninja costume.

steps.npc: Ahem, here we are, At 100 you'll unlock a Karamjan Monkey transformation.
After completing 250 laps, you'll unlock a scary zombie monkey.
With 500 laps finished, you'll get a maniacal monkey.
At 1000 laps, you'll be able transform him into a spooky skeleton monkey,
1500 laps for a little Kruk Jr monkey,
Finally at 2000 laps, he can transform to look like our King Awowogei.
That's okay my friend, come back anytime.
